description: XEMWUL crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C69 H72 Dy4 Na1 O32 3+,3(C1 F3 O3 S1 1-),C1 H4 O1,3(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.586-3.587 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 98.66-100.46°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy4Na(μ2-OH)2L1_4(H2O)5(CH3OH)](CF3SO3)3·3H2O·CH3OH. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 μ2-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 5 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 μ2-OH (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 5 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
